description: c1a (composition). The candidate-set reference of engagement A keeps one candidate only.
c1b (composition). The candidate-set reference of engagement A is marked resolved (its two candidates stay).
c2a (composition). The participation of engagement B carries a third role value that no final claim yielded.
c2b (composition). The earlier claim of human coder A (construction contract), which disagrees with the role values of the participation, is also marked final.
c3a (composition). The model coding v3 records both of its plans on one qualified association instead of one association per plan.
c3b (composition). The model coding v3 loses its prompt specification: only the codebook plan remains.

c4 (composition). In SEM a role and the participation are one node (a sem:Role constraint on sem:hasActor whose rdf:value is the bearer), so a bearer that does not participate can only be written by detaching that node from the engagement: the node keeps its bearer and its role types but no event has it as an actor.
